name: makecode-mcp
description: Drive a MakeCode micro:bit editor from your LLM: load TypeScript, render Blocks previews, and compile to a flashable .hex file.
long_description: Runs a stdio MCP server that opens MakeCode micro:bit (https://makecode.microbit.org) in a Puppeteer-managed tab and exposes a small, stable tool surface for LLM tool-calling: start/end editor sessions, set/get code, render a Blocks PNG of the current editor (or a snippet), and compile to a base64 Universal Hex. Useful for teaching, demos, and programmatic micro:bit code generation. Requires Google Chrome (or Chromium) installed locally — the extension launches it automatically.

headed_mode.title: Headed mode
headed_mode.description: Show each MakeCode session in its own browser window so you can watch the LLM drive the editor. Off by default (runs headless).

chrome_path.title: Chrome executable (optional)
chrome_path.description: Path to Google Chrome or Chromium. Leave blank to auto-detect the system install.
